[P3] 克利斯提昂·约里波瓦（Christian Jolibois）今年352岁哦，他的妈妈是爱尔兰女，这可是个秘密哦。他可以不知疲倦地编出一串接一串星期天的故事来，为了专心致志地写故事，他暂时把自己的“泰诺号”三桅船停靠在了勃艮第的一个小村庄旁边。并且，他还常常和猪、大狗、玫瑰花和鸡在一块儿聊天。

克利斯提昂·艾利施（Christian Heinrich），他是一只勤奋的小鸟，喜欢到处涂涂抹抹的水彩画家，他有一大把看起来很酷的秃头画笔，还带着自己小小的素描本去往许多没人知道的地方。他如今在斯特拉斯堡工作，整天幻想着去海边和鸬鹚聊天。

祝勃艮第、瓦朗耶、里昂内的小朋友们快乐。
——克利斯提昂·约里波瓦

致亚力山大，蓝色星球上最可爱的、最小最小的小鸡，爸爸。
——克利斯提昂·艾利施

[P4] 太阳下山了。小鸡们抓紧时间在睡前疯玩：滑滑梯、荡秋千、踢球、游泳……嘻嘻哈哈！叽叽喳喳！这是一天中最热闹的时候。

“今天到此为止了，孩子们！快点回去睡觉！”
卡梅拉扯开嗓门命令大家。

[P5] 小鸡们很不情愿地往回走。

“快，快点！我都看见狐狸闪光的牙齿啦……
“37，38，39……”卡梅拉仔细地数着，“39……
怎么缺一个？又是这个淘气包，卡梅利多！你在哪儿？
赶紧回来，小心狐狸吃了你！”，

“我才不怕呢！”卡梅利多仰望着闪烁的星空，
他才不在乎妈妈的恐吓呢。

[P6] 8
“哇！一颗流星！流星！”
瞧！一颗美丽的小星星坠落在灌木丛里了。
“我来了，宝贝！”
卡梅利多欢呼着奔向树丛，想凑近了瞧一瞧星星。
自打他从蛋里钻出来，就梦想着这一天了。
9

[P7] 啊，我的天，它正一动不动地躺在沙滩上呢！卡梅利多抑制不住内心的激动！轻轻地走过去。
“可怜的星星！看来这趟旅行把你累坏了。”他轻轻地抚摸着星星，“哦！原来星星这么软，还有股鱼腥味……”

[P8] “我找到星星啦！佩罗，我找到星星啦……”

他抱着星星，欢天喜地跑去告诉老朋友这个难以置信的好消息。

“哈、哈、哈！就是这个吗！一颗从天上坠落的流星！”佩罗放声大笑，“我可怜的卡梅利多，这只是一颗海星……而且已经不太新鲜了！”

慢——瓜！
慢瓜！
慢——瓜！
慢瓜！

[P9] “知道吗，我的小家伙，星星是不存在的！”
哈哈！
“我得给你解释一下，事实上，每当夜晚来临，地球就被一个巨大的黑色漏勺盖起来了，那些星星只是从漏勺的小洞里透出来的光。懂吗？我的小傻瓜！呵呵、呵呵……”

[P10] 卡梅利多伤心极了。
小白羊贝里奥过来安慰他：
“别哭了，卡梅利多，我把你的星星捡回来了。
我告诉你一个秘密，我有一个朋友——伽利略先生，他
和你一样，每天晚上都在看星星呢！
“我们去问问他，说不定会得到一个满意的答案。”
他们来到有座美丽花园的房子前，
这就是天文学家的家。
“好奇怪的家伙！他竟然从管子里看星星！”卡梅利多简直无法相信他看到的一切。

[P11] “哈哈，小猫咪！用这个望远镜，我又发现了好多新的星星，看来，我们在宇宙中并不孤单啊！”
“晚——晚上好！”
“啊，是你啊，贝里奥，”老学者头也不回地说，
“这是你带来的朋友？”
“晚上好，伽利略先生，我叫卡梅利多。嗯，你能让我从这个……这个‘管子机器’里看看星星吗？”
“哇！这些星星离我们好近呀！好像我一伸手就可以够得到……是吧？先生，什么时候我能……能亲手……摸一下真正的星星呢？”卡梅利多兴奋得连说话的声音都变了。
“摸星星？哦，呵呵！呵呵！”伽利略大笑起来。
“等到小鸡也能长出牙吧！”

[P12] 与此同时，在太空中……
“嗨，老师，看呀！那儿有颗美丽的蓝色星球！
“安静点，孩子们！安——静！让我看看我的指南
手册里有没有标记？……嗯！这个星球叫地球。”
“哦！它太美啦！”
“老师，我想上厕所！实在憋不住了！”

[P13] “不能再等一等吗？萨蒂尼，就你事多。呃，好吧，我们就在地球上停一会儿吧。还可以从那里带点纪念品回家……”
“来吧，孩子们，都回到座位上，系好安全带，戴上保护眼镜。”
“机长！能不能再快点儿！”
“快点儿！”
“再快点儿！”

[P14] 经过一晚的工作，天文学家回去睡觉了。两个好朋友也累了，就在凳子下面做上了美梦。
突然，卡梅利多被一阵可怕的巨响惊醒了。一个大火球，从天上降落下来，轰隆隆的响声把房子都快震塌了！
“贝里奥！贝里奥！快醒醒！”

[P15] “太棒了！这里好漂亮！有草地，还有一幢老房子……”
“我不是在做梦吧！这些东西也是一群小鸡！……一群绿色的小鸡……瞧！他们还长着怪怪的牙齿呢！”

[P16] “呀！这是我先看到的！放手！……”
“天哪！这个东西又旧又难看！”
“笑一下，哥们儿，你可对着镜头呢！”
“孩子们，安静点，慢——慢——来！”

[P17] 刚才那阵恐惧的感觉过去后，卡梅利多忍不住想去看看，这个从天上掉下来的“鸡窝”是什么样。
“过来，贝里奥！”
“如果我们回不了家怎么办？”
贝里奥虽然非常不情愿，但还是跟在卡梅利多后面，向火球里走去。
“有人吗？”卡梅利多小心翼翼地问道。
“呜……呜……”

[P18] “我找不到我的靴子了……所有的人都下去了，只把我留在这里，好害怕呀……呜呜……”

“你好！”卡梅利多礼貌地说，“有什么可以帮你的吗？”

小绿鸡睁开眼，看见他俩，立刻停止了哭泣。
“我叫塞勒斯特……我是卡萨夫人班级的。”
“我叫卡梅利多，这位是贝里奥……”

“你们的鸡窝可真棒！”卡梅利多环视着飞船，赞叹道。
“这个东西怎么运转？”贝里奥好奇地指着一个圆桶问道。
“嗯，它和星际发动机一起运转。”小绿鸡兴致勃勃地介绍。
“发动机？什么是发动机？”
“呵呵……你们可真有意思，连发动机都不知道。来，我带你们参观一下吧！”

[P19] “我们是绿色班级的，跟着老师游览各个星球。”小绿鸡非常自豪地向他们解释。
“你们是从星星上来的？”卡梅利多大声喊道，
“看，我说对了吧？真的有星星！”
“当然了。”塞勒斯特说，“看看我们找到的这些漂亮东西，这是我们在学校里的必修课。”
“什么是‘学校’？”
“你从没上过学？”
“嗯……是的！”卡梅利多有点不好意思。
“唉，你们这些男孩子啊！看来我们要从头学起……”

[P20] 塞勒斯特耐心向他们解释：“在我们的银河系中，有十亿颗星星……”
“啊，多少？十亿？”
“嗯，就是很多的意思。”

卡梅利多望着小绿鸡的牙，忍不住问道：“塞勒斯特，你可不要生气，为……为什么你们会长牙？”

“那是很久很久以前的事了，有一天，农场主给我们吃了肉……后来，我们的牙就长出来了。”
“那农场主后来怎么样了？”
“呵呵……我们把他们给吃了，并且占领了他们的农场！……”塞勒斯特突然喊道，“哦，我的靴子！找到我的靴子了！对不起，我得马上下去！快点儿！”

[P21] “我必须找点儿东西带回去，这是老师布置的作业。”
“塞勒斯特，收下它做个纪念吧，”卡梅利多慷慨地把海星送给她，“这是整个地球上，你能找到的唯一一颗星星！”
“你收下吧，很好玩的。”贝里奥补充道，“它很软，而且有股鱼腥味……”
塞勒斯特高兴极了，她从没见过这么漂亮的东西，在他们的星球上，既没有大海也没有沙滩……
“我也送你们一个礼物，”她在背包里翻找起来，
“看！只是一个小玩意，但很有意思！”她双手捧着礼物，激动地送给新朋友。

[P22] “这是金星上的一块碎片，我昨天拿到的！”

“我简直不敢相信！贝里奥，你看到了吗？金星上的！简直太神奇了！”

“我摸到星星了！”
“我摸到星星了！”

“过来！”塞勒斯特趴在地上，用木棍画了一个图，“每到晚上，天空中会出现一组星星，像狐狸似的图案，看到它闪亮的眼睛了吗？那就是我住的地方！记住哦！”

飞船就要返航了，三个小朋友含着泪水，依依不舍地紧紧拥抱……

[P23] “慢慢来，孩子们……
慢——慢——来！……37，
38,39……怎么少了一个！是
塞勒斯特！”卡萨夫人生气地大声喊道，“我们要出发了！塞勒斯特！你在哪儿？”

“你在哪儿？塞勒斯特，快点儿、快！
“老师，你看我带回了什么？地球上的星星！”

[P24] 飞船消失了，烟雾也随之散去。
“我们该回去了。”
“到时间了？”卡梅利多还沉浸在刚才的奇遇中，
“真可惜！”

“你知道大人们会怎么想？我们迟到5分钟，他们
就能扯出一堆事来……”

“再见！再见啦，塞勒斯特！”
“我永远也忘不了你！”

[P25] 两个好朋友决定，对这次奇遇保守秘密，谁也不告诉，“我们已经不是小孩了，对吧？

鸡舍里，日子还像往常一样，早上起床，太阳下山就得睡觉……

“卡梅利多？快回来，我的宝贝，小心狐狸把你吃了……”

“好的，妈妈！再等一分钟！”

“嗨，看哪，卡梅利多！一颗流星，我许了一个愿。”

“我也许了一个愿。”

[P26] 天文学家还是在每天晚上，望着星星说话。

“我现在越来越肯定，在另一个星球有生物存在，
但……现在还不好证实。”

[P27] “生活中肯定还有比睡觉更好玩的事情！”大小卡梅拉们一直都抱有这样的信念。他们执着地追求那些种群中认为不可想象的事情。去看大海、去摘星星、去寻找“丢失”的太阳……一路上处处坎坷、历经艰难，但总是逢凶化吉、化险为夷。最后还能收获超乎想象的回报和异乎寻常的果实。
我们可以把卡梅拉当作一种象征，一种成长路上必不可少的“伴侣”。
读不一样的卡梅拉，成就与众不同的你！
——儿童阅读推广人 萝卜探长
3~5岁亲子共读
5岁以上自主阅读
ISBN 978-7-5391-3518-2
定价：18.00元

[P3] Christian Jolibois is 352 years old this year. His mother is Irish, and that's a secret. He can tirelessly come up with one Sunday story after another. To focus on writing, he temporarily docked his 'Tano' three-masted ship in a small village in Burgundy. And he often chats with pigs, big dogs, roses, and chickens.

Christian Heinrich is a diligent little bird, a watercolor painter who loves to paint everywhere. He has a bunch of cool-looking bald paintbrushes and carries his small sketchbook to many unknown places. He now works in Strasbourg, always dreaming of going to the seaside to chat with cormorants.

Wishing the children in Burgundy, Valence, and Lyon happiness.
—Christian Jolibois

To Alexander, the cutest, tiniest little chick on the blue planet, Dad.
—Christian Heinrich

[P4] The sun had set. The chicks were having a wild time before bedtime: sliding down slides, swinging on swings, playing soccer, swimming...嘻嘻哈哈!叽叽喳喳! This was the liveliest time of the day.

"That's enough for today, children! Time to go back and sleep!" 
Carmela shouted loudly, commanding everyone.

[P5] The chicks reluctantly walked back.

"Hurry, hurry! I can see the fox's shiny teeth..."
"37, 38, 39..." Camille counted carefully, "39... 
One is missing again? That rascal, Caramel! Where are you? 
Hurry back, or the fox will eat you!"

"I'm not afraid!" Caramel looked up at the twinkling stars, 
he didn't care about his mother's warnings.

[P6] 8
"Wow! A shooting star! A shooting star!"
Look! A beautiful little star has fallen into the bushes.
"I'm here, baby!"
Caramelito cheers and runs toward the bushes, wanting to get a closer look at the star.
Ever since he hatched from his egg, he has dreamed of this day.
9

[P7] Oh my, it's lying motionless on the sand! Camille couldn't contain his excitement and walked over gently.
"Poor star! This journey must have tired you out," he said gently, stroking the star. "Oh! I see, stars are so soft, and they even smell like fish..."

[P8] "I found a star! Pedro, I found a star..."

He hugged the star and happily ran to tell his old friend this unbelievable good news.

"Ha, ha, ha! Is this it? A meteor that fell from the sky!" Pedro laughed loudly. "Poor Camille, this is just a sea star... and it's not very fresh anymore!"

Slow—go!
Slow-go!
Slow—go!
Slow-go!

[P9] "Do you know, my little fellow, stars don't exist!"
Haha!
"I have to explain to you. In fact, whenever night falls, the Earth is covered by a huge black ladle, and those stars are just light coming through the small holes in the ladle. Got it? My little fool! Haha, haha..."

[P10] Camille was heartbroken.
Little white lamb Béria came to comfort him:
"Don't cry, Camille, I've found your star.
I have a secret to tell you. I have a friend—Mr. Galileo. He's just like you, watching the stars every night!
"Let's go ask him. Maybe we'll get a satisfying answer."
They arrived at a house with a beautiful garden.
This was the home of the astronomer.
"What a strange fellow! He's actually looking at stars through a tube!" Camille could hardly believe what he saw.

[P11] "Ha ha, little kitten! With this telescope, I've discovered so many new stars again. Look, we're not alone in the universe!"
"Evening—good evening!"
"Ah, it's you, Berio," the old scholar said without turning his head,
"Is this your friend?"
"Good evening, Galileo, I'm Camille. Um, could you let me look at the stars through this... this 'tube machine'?"
"Wow! These stars are so close! It's like I could reach out and touch them... right? Sir, when can I... can I actually... touch a real star?" Camille's voice trembled with excitement.
"Touch a star? Oh, hehe! Hehe!" Galileo laughed.
"Wait until chickens grow teeth!"

[P12] Meanwhile, in space……
"Hey, teacher, look! There's a beautiful blue planet over there!"
"Quiet, children! Quiet! Let me check my guidebook to see if it's marked…… Ah! This planet is called Earth."
"Oh! It's so beautiful!"
"Teacher, I need to go to the bathroom! I can't hold it anymore!"

[P13] "Can't we wait just a little longer? Sartini, you're always so fussy. Well, okay, let's stop on Earth for a bit. We can even bring back some souvenirs..."
"Come on, children, back to your seats, fasten your seatbelts, and put on your protective goggles."
"Captain! Can't we go any faster!"
"Faster!"
"Even faster!"

[P14] After a night's work, the astronomer went back to sleep. The two good friends were tired too, and fell asleep under the stool.
Suddenly, Camembert was awakened by a terrible loud noise. A huge fireball fell from the sky, and the booming sound almost shook the house to pieces!
"Berio! Berio! Wake up!"

[P15] "Great! This place is so beautiful! There's grass, and an old house..."
"Am I dreaming? These things are also chicks!... A group of green chicks... Look! They even have weird teeth!"

[P16] "Hey! I saw it first! Let go!..."
"Goodness! This thing is old and ugly!"
"Smile, buddy, you're in front of the camera!"
"Kids, quiet down, slow—slow—down!"

[P17] After the wave of fear passed, Camille couldn't help but want to go and see what this 'nest' that fell from the sky was like.
"Come on, Bélier!"
"What if we can't go back home?"
Bélier, although very unwilling, still followed Camille into the fireball.
"Is anyone there?" Camille asked cautiously.
"Quack... quack..."

[P18] "I can't find my boots... everyone else went down, and they left me here. I'm so scared... waaah..."

"Hello!" said Camille politely. "Is there anything I can help you with?"

The little green chick opened her eyes, saw them, and immediately stopped crying.
"My name is Celeste... I'm in Mrs. Casa's class."
"I'm Camille, and this is Bélier..."

"Your chicken coop is amazing!" Camille said, looking around the spaceship in admiration.
"How does this thing work?" Bélier asked curiously, pointing at a round barrel.
"Well, it works together with the interstellar engine," the little green chick explained enthusiastically.
"Engine? What's an engine?"
"Hehe... you two are so funny, not even knowing what an engine is. Come on, I'll give you a tour!"

[P19] "We are the Green Class, traveling with our teacher to visit different planets," the little green chicken explained proudly.
"Are you from the stars?" Camille shouted,
"Look, I told you so! There really are stars!"
"Of course," Celeste said, "look at all these lovely things we've found. It's our required course at school."
"What is 'school'?"
"You've never been to school?"
"Well... yes!" Camille said, feeling a bit embarrassed.
"Oh, you boys! Looks like we'll have to start from scratch..."

[P20] Sélestre patiently explained to them: “In our galaxy, there are ten billion stars…”
“Ah, how many? Ten billion?”
“Well, it just means a lot.”

Camille looked at the little green chicken’s teeth and couldn’t help asking: “Sélestre, don’t get angry, but… why do you have teeth?”

“That was a long, long time ago. One day, the farm owner fed us meat… and then our teeth grew out.”
“What happened to the farm owner afterward?”
“Hehe… we ate them, and took over their farm!…” Sélestre suddenly shouted, “Oh, my boots! I found my boots! Sorry, I have to go down right away! Hurry up!”

[P21] "I must find something to take back, it's the teacher's homework."
"Sélest, take this as a souvenir," Camille generously gave her the starfish, "this is the only star you can find on the whole Earth!"
"Take it, it's fun," Bélier added, "it's soft, and has a fishy smell..."
Sélest was thrilled; she had never seen such a beautiful thing before. On their planet, there was neither sea nor beach...
"I'll give you a gift too," she rummaged in her backpack,
"Look! Just a little trinket, but very interesting!" She held the gift in her hands and excitedly gave it to her new friends.

[P22] "This is a piece of Venus, I got it yesterday!"

"I can't believe it! Berio, did you see? From Venus! It's absolutely amazing!"

"I touched a star!"
"I touched a star!"

"Come here!" Celeste lay on the ground, drawing a picture with a stick. "Every night, a group of stars appears in the sky, forming a pattern like a fox. Can you see its shining eyes? That's where I live! Remember!"

The spaceship was about to return. The three friends hugged tightly, tears in their eyes, reluctant to part...

[P23] "Slowly, children... Slow—slow—go! ...37, 38, 39... One is missing! It's Celeste!" Mrs. Kasa angrily shouted, "We're leaving! Celeste! Where are you?"

"Where are you? Celeste, hurry up, hurry!"
"Teacher, look what I brought back! A star from Earth!"

[P24] The spaceship disappeared, and the smoke dissipated.
"We should go back now."
"Is it time?" Camille was still immersed in the recent adventure,
"What a pity!"

"You know what the grown-ups will think? If we're five minutes late, they
will make a big fuss about it..."

"Goodbye! Goodbye, Celeste!"
"I'll never forget you!"

[P25] Two good friends decided to keep their adventure a secret, telling no one, "We're not kids anymore, right?"

In the chicken coop, life went on as usual—getting up in the morning, going to sleep when the sun set...

"Camelot? Come back, my darling, watch out for the fox..."

"Okay, Mom! Just one more minute!"

"Hey, look, Camelot! A shooting star—I made a wish."

"I made a wish too."

[P26] Astronomers still look at the stars every night and talk to them.

"I'm becoming more and more certain that there is life on another planet,
but... it's still not proven."

[P27] "There must be things in life even more fun than sleeping!" The little Camels have always held this belief. They persistently pursue things that their kind considers unimaginable—going to see the sea, picking stars, searching for the 'lost' sun... Along the way, they face countless hardships and difficulties, but always manage to turn danger into safety and overcome obstacles. In the end, they reap rewards beyond imagination and extraordinary fruits.
We can regard Camela as a symbol, an indispensable 'companion' on the journey of growth.
Read a different Camela, and become a unique you!
—Children's Reading Promoter, Carrot Detective
Ages 3-5: Parent-child reading
Ages 5+: Independent reading
ISBN 978-7-5391-3518-2
Price: 18.00 RMB
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《我想有颗星星》的封面，展示了书名、作者、译者信息，以及一只红色小鸡和一只灰色小羊在星空下的农场场景，背景有流星划过。
[P2] 本页为绘本《我想有颗星星》的封面，展示了书名、作者、译者及出版社信息，画面中有三只小鸡站在农场场景中。
[P3] 本页为绘本《我想有颗星星》的版权页和作者介绍页，左侧包含两位作者的简介、获奖记录、版权信息及图书在版编目（CIP）数据，右侧配有插图及作者的题词，分别致小朋友们和自己的孩子。
[P4] 太阳下山后，小鸡们在农场里尽情玩耍，有的滑滑梯、荡秋千、游泳，场面热闹非凡；随后母鸡卡梅拉大声命令它们回家睡觉。
[P5] 小鸡们不情愿地回家，母鸡卡梅拉清点数量时发现卡梅利多不见了，担心他被狐狸吃掉；而卡梅利多独自在树上仰望星空，表示自己并不害怕。
[P6] 卡梅利多在树上看到流星，兴奋地呼喊；随后他发现一颗小星星坠落在灌木丛中，便欢呼着奔向它，实现了自己长久以来的梦想。
[P7] 卡梅利多发现一颗坠落的星星躺在沙滩上，他激动地走近，轻轻抚摸并感叹星星柔软且有鱼腥味。
[P8] 卡梅利多兴奋地抱着一颗坠落的星星跑去告诉朋友佩罗，但佩罗却大笑说那只是不新鲜的海星，周围的小羊们也惊呼着逃跑。
[P9] 卡梅利多抱着一颗星星去找朋友佩罗，佩罗嘲笑他说那只是不新鲜的海星，其他小羊们也惊慌逃跑。画面左侧一只大鸟嘲笑小羊们，右侧卡梅利多抱着星星跑过，小羊坐在墙上惊恐地看着。
[P10] 卡梅利多因星星被误认为海星而伤心，小白羊贝里奥安慰他并提议去请教自己的朋友伽利略先生。他们来到天文学家的家，看到伽利略先生用望远镜看星星，卡梅利多对此感到非常惊讶。
[P11] 卡梅利多在朋友贝里奥的陪同下拜访天文学家伽利略，请求用望远镜看星星，并兴奋地表达想触摸星星的愿望，但伽利略笑着拒绝，认为这不可能。
[P12] 在太空中，一群外星学生在老师带领下观察地球，他们惊叹于地球的美丽，但其中一名学生因急着上厕所而打断了课堂。
[P13] 外星学生在老师带领下观察地球，其中一名学生因急着上厕所而请求停留，老师同意短暂停靠地球并带回纪念品。其他学生则催促机长加速返回。
[P14] 天文学家和两个好朋友睡着后，一个大火球从天而降，卡梅利多被巨响惊醒，大声呼喊贝里奥。画面右侧显示红色飞船降落，扬起烟尘，左侧是望远镜和睡在凳子下的小羊。
[P15] 外星飞船降落地球，外星学生兴奋地发现草地和老房子，同时惊讶于地面上绿色、长着怪牙的小鸡（实为外星人）。
[P16] 外星学生在地球上的老房子里兴奋地探索，争抢物品并拍照，老师则试图维持秩序，要求他们安静并慢慢来。
[P17] 卡梅利多和贝里奥鼓起勇气，走进从天而降的红色飞船，卡梅利多小心翼翼地询问是否有人，飞船内传来“呜……呜……”的声音。
[P18] 外星小鸡塞勒斯特因找不到靴子而哭泣，卡梅利多和贝里奥上前安慰并自我介绍。随后，他们进入飞船内部，卡梅利多称赞飞船像鸡窝，贝里奥好奇询问设备运作，塞勒斯特则热情地介绍星际发动机，并主动提出带他们参观。
[P19] 小绿鸡向卡梅利多和贝里奥介绍他们来自绿色班级，正在星际旅行；卡梅利多兴奋地确认了星星的存在；塞勒斯特展示他们收集的物品，并解释这是学校的必修课；卡梅利多对‘学校’感到陌生，塞勒斯特表示需要从头教起。
[P20] 塞勒斯特向卡梅利多和贝里奥解释他们银河系中有十亿颗星星，并讲述了他们因吃了农场主的肉而长出牙齿的来历。卡梅利多对此感到好奇并提问，塞勒斯特随后因找到靴子而急着离开。
[P21] 卡梅利多和贝里奥将海星送给外星小鸡塞勒斯特作为纪念，塞勒斯特则回赠礼物，双方互赠礼物，友谊加深。
[P22] 塞勒斯特向卡梅利多和贝里奥展示从金星带回的碎片，三人兴奋地触摸星星；随后塞勒斯特在地上画出她家的星图，飞船即将返航，三个小伙伴含泪拥抱告别。
[P23] 卡萨夫人在飞船旁清点学生人数，发现塞勒斯特不见了，焦急地呼唤她；而塞勒斯特则兴奋地从飞船中跑出，向老师展示她从地球带回的星星。
[P24] 飞船升空离去，卡梅利多和贝里奥在草地上目送，依依不舍地向塞勒斯特道别，并表达对这段友谊的珍视。
[P25] 卡梅利多和贝里奥决定保守与外星小鸡塞勒斯特相遇的秘密，并在夜晚仰望星空，各自对着流星许下心愿，画面温馨而充满童真。
[P26] 画面描绘了一位天文学家在夜晚用望远镜观测星空，旁边放着一只黄色的靴子，文字表达了对地外生命的猜想与探索的执着。
[P27] 本页为绘本的封底，包含一段关于卡梅拉系列的推荐语，强调其象征意义和对儿童成长的积极影响，并注明了适读年龄、ISBN及定价信息。
